name: Nations
overview: Scripture reveals that nations are divinely established entities through which God’s blessing and purpose unfold, as seen in His promise to make Abraham a great nation and a company of nations (Genesis 12:2; 35:11). The spiritual condition of a nation is crucial, for righteousness exalts a nation while sin brings reproach (Proverbs 14:34), and blessedness belongs to those nations whose God is the LORD (Psalms 33:12). Ultimately, nations that refuse to serve God face judgment and destruction, whereas God’s kingdom will be characterized by peace and salvation (Isaiah 60:12,18).
